how: A Stop Novadeck continues with a message (t1 works on 'Hold then stop' while t2 sends to it), then a ring of an idle agent (t1 asks t2). `prompts`: every prompt the harness submitted, as its UserPromptSubmit hook gave it, or for Antigravity, whose hooks name none, each typed entry its transcript records. `deliveries`: where the delivered messages landed in its records, the text before them cut to 160 characters.
